source.rendererAssessment: Pinned rsmv a92b8920b9b9842adde78822646ecad1a6f4fc15 src/viewer/tabs/simplemodes.tsx ItemCameraMode and src/viewer/threejsrender.ts makeUIRenderer support a browser inventory camera at 36x32; src/headless/api.ts renderAppearance exports a 500x700 model view. Browser/WebGL stack unavailable in retained terrain runtime; declared Wiki inventory images used.
source.dimensionsPolicy: Preserve original inventory PNG dimensions; application contains each within a 32px box.

hashScopes.sha256: Saved PNG HTTP response body bytes
hashScopes.downloadSha1: Saved PNG HTTP response body bytes
hashScopes.wikiSha1: MediaWiki stored upload file bytes; may differ from CDN-optimized response bytes
hashScopes.timestamp: MediaWiki upload version timestamp; not the HTTP Last-Modified or download timestamp

headers.content-security-policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline' data:; font-src data:; img-src data: 'self'; media-src data: 'self'; sandbox

representativeHead.scope: HEAD checked after downloads; not historical GET headers for each downloaded file.

deliveryEvidence.interpretation: The representative response confirms Cloudflare Polish optimized the served PNG encoding. Upload hashes and delivery hashes have separate scopes. No original-versus-delivered pixel comparison or lossless-mode claim is made.
